{{Top|leg}}
The '''Jetters Bar''' was a nightclub that was affiliated with several well-known criminal organizations. Furthermore, the owner was a covert agent of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]], and often aided the IBC by placing [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]] on individuals who were not paying their loan payments.
